mapper.select: SELECT id, check_id, sku_id, location_id, system_qty, actual_qty, diff_qty, created_at, updated_at FROM stock_check_item WHERE check_id = #{checkId} ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT id, check_id, sku_id, location_id, system_qty, actual_qty, diff_qty, created_at, updated_at FROM stock_check_item WHERE id = #{id}
